The source window first appears at i+1=r_(k-1), giving r3=38 and r_k=2^(r_(k-1)-2)+r_(k-1)-1. The start shift and no-00 extension give all four orientations/parities, and the first-containing stage gives A_i=2K_i+1. Independently constructed stages 1..18, checked full maximal alternating lengths and r3, and the integer r4=68719476773. The unbounded claim is an induction, not a finite extrapolation.
